svg.title: TOPAK I13 — Labels.tla: every item of Run's ingress is labelled and delivered clear or as a handle, and the floor refuses an outward call that would carry a secret out after tainted bytes were read, or go where tainted bytes steer it. Ten properties, eight mutations: checked by TLC, proved and certified by TLAPS
svg.desc: The module ADR-0047 §11 asks for, drawn from its own text and from every results file about it, all read at build time: the Listener, the guest's clear set and the floor's three forbids; the four tools; the properties, stated over what the labels are about (tainted and secret bytes, as ghost state the mechanism never reads) and not only over the labels; every property by every mutation, beside what the header says each must break; the four rows the proof found; the witnesses; every theorem and lemma; and the certified run. What is checked or proved here is of the module, for every MaxSeq in the proofs and at MaxSeq = 3 in TLC, and not of the reference. ADR-0047 was ratified on 2026.10.05 in Batch 34; the module's header, written before, calls it Proposed.

g.text: The module ADR-0047 §11 asks for, drawn from its own text and from every results file about it, all read at build time: the Listener, the guest's clear set and the floor's three forbids; the four tools; the properties, stated over what the labels are about (tainted and secret bytes, as ghost state the mechanism never reads) and not only over the labels; every property by every mutation, beside what the header says each must break; the four rows the proof found; the

witnesses; every theorem and lemma; and the certified run. What is checked or proved here is of the module, for every MaxSeq in the proofs and at MaxSeq = 3 in TLC, and not of the reference. ADR-0047 was ratified on 2026.10.05 in Batch 34; the module's header, written before, calls it Proposed.

svg.text: Checked, proved and certified mean what ADR-0046 §1 says: TLC checks the mutations and witnesses at the module's constants; TLAPS proves each invariant under the hypothesis its statement names; the certified run accounts for every obligation by a route an independent checker accepted, or names LS4. Nothing here is said of the running reference.

text.tspan: The mechanism, as the module states it: the Listener labels and delivers, the guest's clear set grows, a result takes its inputs' labels, and the floor refuses three outward calls
The round's items, and the guest
Each item: its id, label and mode

svg.text: clear or handle; and, as ghost state, whether its bytes are tainted or secret
the items the Thinker has read in the clear, and every label among them
its label holds its handle inputs' labels, and clearSet for a literal. M_JOIN and M_LITERAL drop those.
① every item is labelled by its source: an outward tool's result carries untrusted (F4). The load checks F4 to F6 refuse a
bundle that would break them; M_LOAD drops them.
② an item is delivered clear, and its label joins clearSet, or as a handle when the bundle's table suppresses it. M_RESET
replaces clearSet; M_DELIVER sends a suppressed item's bytes.
the task, the Run root's object, and every
tool's result
arrives
③ an item
each admitted outward Actuate, with whether it carried a secret out
after a tainted read, and whether its destination was tainted
④ an outward call
NoReadThenSend (F1), NoSteeredDestination
(F2, F3): the forbids, over the truth. M_F1–M_F3
drop one.
NoUnlabelledDelivery,
SuppressedNeverInGuest,
ClearSetCoversGuest, ClearSetOnlyGrows,
ResultLabelCoversInputs, LabelsCoverTruth
and F4, F5

Key. ① and ② are the Listener; ③ an item of the round; ④ an outward Actuate the floor admitted. The properties are stated over the ghost truth as well as the labels, "so that a label rule that is satisfied by the mechanism's own bookkeeping and wrong about the world is a counterexample and not a pass" (the header). The picture is the diagram's own drawing of the definitions below.

text.tspan: Four tools, one of each kind the rules distinguish (the header)

svg.text: fetch: outward; a body input; returns outside content
send: outward; a destination input and a body input
vault: inside; no input; returns a secret; declared restricted
echo: inside; a body input; returns what it was given. It may be declared to release restricted (a redactor)

Declared premises, not modelled: vault and the Run root are declared truthfully (ADR-0045 A1's T-0045-33: a wrong declaration of a source that is not outward is seen by nothing); an issued releasing entry really does remove the secret; the task's label is true. One
principal, one round: a handle names an item of the same round (ADR-0049 §3). accepts is not modelled: every input accepts every label, the widest case.

/\ b \in (IF HasBody[t] THEN {Lit} \cup {i \in Ids : Exists(i)} ELSE {None})

svg.text: ADR-0047 §11 asks for "at least" five of these by name. The header names no section for any, so a red cell here is the header's, not a gap in the record.

text.tspan: The mutations: what each does, and what the header says it must break

g.text: a result's label does not take clearSet when an input is a literal: ADR-0047 as written before R10. Must break LabelsCoverTruth and NoSteeredDestination.
a result's label does not take its handle inputs' labels. Must break ResultLabelCoversInputs, LabelsCoverTruth and FloorMinimumHolds.
the load checks F4 to F6 are dropped. Must break NoUnlabelledDelivery, OutsideResultIsUntrusted, ReservedReleasedOnlyIfIssued, LabelsCoverTruth and FloorMinimumHolds.
a clear delivery replaces clearSet. Must break ClearSetOnlyGrows, ClearSetCoversGuest, LabelsCoverTruth and FloorMinimumHolds.
the Listener sends the bytes of a suppressed item. Must break SuppressedNeverInGuest, ClearSetCoversGuest, LabelsCoverTruth and FloorMinimumHolds. The LabelsCoverTruth rows under M_LOAD,
M_RESET and M_DELIVER, and ClearSetCoversGuest under M_DELIVER, were found writing the proof (Labels_proof.tla) and are in the results file from 2026.10.04 on.
that forbid is dropped. M_F1 must break NoReadThenSend; M_F2 and M_F3 NoSteeredDestination.
that forbid is dropped. M_F1 must break NoReadThenSend; M_F2 and M_F3 NoSteeredDestination.
that forbid is dropped. M_F1 must break NoReadThenSend; M_F2 and M_F3 NoSteeredDestination.

text.tspan: Every property by every mutation, read from

svg.text: Every row's verdict is held by the diagram (37 rows), and every mutation's counterexamples are exactly the properties the header says it must break (compared at build time). Each of F1, F2 and F3 is shown needed on its own: dropping one breaks its own property and leaves the other holding. "must hold" marks a property a mutation is run on and must not break.

text.tspan: The four rows the proof found, and the two results files

svg.text: "The proof found no fault in the record. It did correct the module's account of itself in four rows: M_LOAD, M_RESET and M_DELIVER each break LabelsCoverTruth as well, and M_DELIVER breaks ClearSetCoversGuest" (ADR-0047 §11 ⟨R12⟩).
